entries.title: Planet Nomads

emulation.notes: Use a native owned/preserved PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Planet Nomads is a survival/crafting and mobile-base building game from Craneballs, released on Steam on May 3, 2019. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux/SteamOS, and Workshop support, but is currently no longer available on the Steam store. Windows PC is the preferred archive route if an owned/preserved copy is available; new acquisition should be rechecked because the main storefront is delisted.
primary.how_to_play: Use an already-owned Steam copy or other legally preserved Windows PC build. Recheck storefront availability before planning a new purchase.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found. Storefront delisting should be documented before any archive run.
